latest.title: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as U.S. inflation data looms, Harmony exploit rattles altcoins

latest.title: CoreWeave surges 18% in premarket after a 'cleaner quarter'. Here's what's happening
latest.description: AI cloud giant CoreWeave jumped in premarket trading after reporting that its second-quarter revenue doubled on surging AI demand from hyperscalers.

latest.title: China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus makes first international flight — could COMAC challenge the aviation duopoly?
latest.description: China’s C919 has made its first scheduled international commercial flight, a milestone in COMAC’s bid to challenge Boeing and Airbus globally.

latest.title: Binance, RedotPay clash over fate of Singapore lawsuit
latest.description: Amid a $473 million legal dispute, RedotPay says it expects Binance to end its Singapore case, while Binance says its claims remain active.

latest.title: Bank of England to test stablecoin, digital currency use in cross-border finance
latest.description: The BOE-led Digital Pound Lab will test trade-finance interoperability, in which exporters receive stablecoins while importers settle in a potential digital pound.

latest.title: Bitcoin miners earn under 0.7% of revenue from fees in new 10-year low
latest.description: Bitcoin miners showed a “concerning” trend of pivoting to AI amid a profit squeeze as transaction-fee income barely bounced from 10-year lows of 0.52% of revenue.

latest.title: New York City Council announces probe into prediction market platforms’ marketing strategies
latest.description: In letters to four prediction market platforms, City Council Speaker Julie Menin said the council was also actively considering legislation to address concerns.

latest.title: CoreWeave surges 16% on $2.58 billion revenue quarter as AI infrastructure demand eclipses crypto
latest.description: Booming AI demand sends CRWV up 16% and lifts IREN and CIFR as investors favor computing infrastructure over crypto.

latest.title: Fidelity moves to add staking, quarterly payouts to near $900 million ether ETF
latest.description: The fund would keep 85% of gross staking rewards, with the remaining 15% going to service providers.

latest.title: CFTC Invokes Emergency Powers to Keep Kalshi Trading Despite New York Suit
latest.description: Kalshi triggered the order, notifying the agency of a market emergency after New York moved to bar its contracts nationwide.

latest.title: Chinese tech giant Tencent posts revenue beat on accelerating games sales, AI-driven ads
latest.description: Tencent stock was down 26% so far in 2026 as the company faces intense competition in China in AI and investors grow jittery about its rising spending.

latest.title: Crypto companies urge AI firms to give Bitcoin developers early access
latest.description: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and other industry participants urged AI companies to offer early access to their frontier models to aid Bitcoin and open-source developers in their cybersecurity efforts.

latest.title: One overlooked group has added $1.78 billion of selling pressure to bitcoin market
latest.description: Public miners are an underappreciated source of supply hitting the market right at the margin.

latest.title: World's largest sovereign wealth fund posts record $184 billion profit as it reveals SpaceX stake for the first time
latest.description: The fund — currently valued at around $2.34 trillion — is an investor in more than 7,000 companies across 60 countries.

latest.title: Treasury yields are little changed as investors await key inflation data
latest.description: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — was largely flat at 4.682%.

latest.title: Hormuz closure squeezes global economy as oil demand destruction intensifies, IEA says
latest.description: The IEA expects oil demand to fall by 1.6 million barrels a day in 2026 as high fuel prices and Strait of Hormuz disruptions weigh on consumption.

latest.title: Sen. Darline Graham advances to Republican special primary runoff in South Carolina
latest.description: Progressive Democrats keep their winning streak rolling in Minnesota.

latest.title: Inside the fake crypto startup that fooled North Korean IT workers
latest.description: Suspected North Koreans IT workers joined a fake crypto startup — without realizing their every move was being tracked to extract valuable intel.

latest.title: Why the historic U.S.-Japan intervention has failed to halt the yen’s slide
latest.description: The Japanese yen has erased about half of the gains from an unprecedented U.S.-Japan intervention less than two weeks ago.
